title: Felt Rain on Concrete
description: A half-time UK rap-pop beat built on a slow CasioRZ1 kick and warm felt-piano chords, leaving wide reflective space for a vocal. It climbs to a glassy first peak, sinks into a hushed piano valley, then opens into a brighter, fuller second peak before fading back to rain.
